the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: The forward direction is functoriality of equidimensionality. For the converse, the members of the fppf covering are universally open, so the base-changed morphism f_i is open and the support of the pulled back cycle is the inverse image of the support; hence the closure of the pulled back support is the inverse image of the closure W, has relative dimension at most r over S_i by assumption, and the cited dimension-of-fibres lemma together with joint surjectivity of the covering gives relative dimension at most r for W over S (source lines 1609-1624)
